Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
The Role
 Drive technical excellence and architectural decisions for high-performance frontend solutions that power exceptional gaming experiences.
 AI-Driven Engineering Culture:
 We are actively building an AI-driven engineering organization with a clear and deliberate stance: artificial intelligence is a core part of how we build and deliver software — not an experiment, not a trend, and not an optional add-on.
AI is embedded into our engineering workflows, from system design and prototyping to refactoring, testing, and code review. We expect engineers to be fully comfortable working in AI-driven environments and to treat AI as a primary productivity multiplier. Strong engineering judgment, architectural ownership, and accountability remain essential—AI amplifies our engineers, it doesn’t replace responsibility for technical decisions
 What You Will Be Doing
 Lead technical strategy and architecture for scalable CMS applications, establishing performance foundations for large-scale projects
 Drive frontend infrastructure optimization and Core Web Vitals improvements across multiple products
 Oversee code reviews and maintain high standards for code quality and maintainability
 Communicate technical concepts and progress effectively to product owners and non-technical stakeholders
 Continuously optimize development processes and workflows to enhance team productivity
 Collaborate with remote product management teams to deliver customer-facing web applications
 What We Are Looking For
 Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, and Next.js with App Router
 Extensive experience with internationalization (i18n) lifecycle for large-scale applications, including integration with translation management systems like Crowdin
 Proficiency with monorepo tools such as NX or Turborepo
 Experience integrating third-party APIs, analytics, and A/B testing solutions
 Proven track record with SEO optimizations and PageSpeed improvements (CLS, INP, etc.)
 Strong UI/UX skills with Figma and building responsive, consumer-facing web applications
 Why you will love it
 You'll architect solutions that directly impact millions of players while working in a high-pace, high-growth environment where your technical leadership shapes the future of social gaming. With the freedom to innovate and take ownership, you'll drive meaningful improvements that enhance both user experience and team productivity. Plus, you'll collaborate with a globally distributed team that values ego-free collaboration and continuous learning.
 About Patrianna
 Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.
We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent—smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.
We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas—nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.
